effect_description_eng:
When any of your [Ver.3] trait Digimon would digivolve into this card, for each of their face-down digivolution cards, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing this Digimon's bottom face-down digivolution card, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
